statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-116320 (PostgreSQL plperl array and hash conversion use-after-free executes arbitrary code): dropping the final reference to a Perl array or hash while PostgreSQL is converting it lets an object creator run code as the operating system user running the server. It is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 16.16 for major version 16. The PostgreSQL security page, https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116320/, lists 16.16 as the fixed release for 16, and the 16.16 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.16/, list this CVE. The fix on the REL_16_STABLE branch is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/adbbabe18ad7dda6a521ee3af55fdd39b4b47d6d, which carries the trailers "Security: CVE-2026-116320" and "Backpatch-through: 14", is contained in the REL_16_16 tag and not in REL_16_15, and changes src/pl/plperl/plperl.c and the hstore_plperl and jsonb_plperl transforms (contrib/hstore_plperl/hstore_plperl.c and contrib/jsonb_plperl/jsonb_plperl.c) so that PostgreSQL holds its own reference on a Perl array or hash while it converts it; it changes no other file. Alpine's postgresql16 16.16-r0 on the 3.23-stable branch upgrades to the upstream 16.16 release and lists CVE-2026-116320 under 16.16-r0 in its secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/859fa0795e895af033fab32094a83301f2b4d8ff/community/postgresql16/APKBUILD. None of the Alpine patches applied in that APKBUILD change the files the fix touches. The DHI postgresql16 16.16-r0 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from that APKBUILD and the upstream PostgreSQL 16.16 source tarball. The DHI Alpine 3.23 package repository (x86_64 and aarch64) publishes packages built from source postgresql16 at 16.13-r0, 16.14-r0, 16.15-r0 and 16.16-r0; we downloaded the packages named below for every one of those builds on both architectures, each checked against its index checksum. The vulnerable code is in PL/Perl, usr/lib/postgresql16/plperl.so, which the postgresql16-plperl subpackage ships in every published build on both architectures, and in the hstore_plperl transform, usr/lib/postgresql16/hstore_plperl.so, which the postgresql16-plperl-contrib subpackage ships in every build in which that subpackage is published. 16.14-r0 for x86_64 is published without the postgresql16-plperl-contrib, -plpython3, -plpython3-contrib and -pltcl subpackages. In the 16.16-r0 build the postgres server binary, usr/libexec/postgresql16/postgres, reports PostgreSQL 16.16 on both x86_64 and aarch64, and in each earlier build (16.13-r0, 16.14-r0 and 16.15-r0) it reports that older 16.x release on both architectures. The earlier builds are upstream releases before 16.16, so they are affected; 16.16-r0 and later carry the fix.

Alpine's postgresql18 18.7-r0 on the 3.24-stable branch upgrades to the upstream 18.7 release and lists CVE-2026-116320 under 18.7-r0 in its secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/33a57d3919ee0227231f5a3e599540514584e309/main/postgresql18/APKBUILD. None of the Alpine patches applied in that APKBUILD change the files the fix touches. The DHI postgresql18 18.7-r0 packages for Alpine 3.24 are built from that APKBUILD and the upstream PostgreSQL 18.7 source tarball. The DHI Alpine 3.24 package repository (main and security, x86_64 and aarch64) publishes packages built from source postgresql18 at 18.4-r0, 18.6-r0 and 18.7-r0. The vulnerable code is in PL/Perl, usr/lib/postgresql18/plperl.so, which the postgresql18-plperl subpackage ships in every published build on both architectures. The hstore_plperl transform, usr/lib/postgresql18/hstore_plperl.so, is in the postgresql18-plperl-contrib subpackage of every published build on both architectures. In the 18.7-r0 build the postgres server binary reports PostgreSQL 18.7 on both x86_64 and aarch64, and in each earlier build (18.4-r0 and 18.6-r0) it reports that older 18.x release on both architectures. The earlier builds are upstream releases before 18.7, so they are affected; 18.7-r0 and later carry the fix.

PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-116320, a use after free in PL/Perl when the last reference to a Perl array or hash is dropped while PostgreSQL is converting it, in 17.12; earlier 17 releases are affected (https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116320/, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-116320). The server binary in this owner's 17.12-0 build and in its rebuild of Debian's 17.12-0+deb13u1 reports PostgreSQL 17.12 on amd64 and arm64, so both carry the fix. The 17.11-1 build and the current rebuild of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1 report PostgreSQL 17.11, and the earlier rebuilds of Debian's 17.10-0+deb13u1 and 17.11-0+deb13u1, no longer in the repository, package PostgreSQL 17.10 and 17.11. All of these are affected and sort below 17.12-0. PL/Perl ships in this owner's postgresql-plperl-17 package built from Debian's source; the 17.11-1 and 17.12-0 packages do not include it.
